name: Kureha
source:
"Because of you, I was able to live. Don't go anywhere, stay by my side."

On the day of her twelfth birthday, she made a contract with the Tengu Clan. She became a "key" to protect the treasure. The people around her say she was "born to be loved."

Because she is so beautiful and fragile, she is called "Chou Hime" by the Tengu Clan. She calls herself Tenkai's fiancée and wishes to be by his side like in the past.

[Translated from [url=http://mikatuki.sakura.ne.jp/m/contents/character/img/chara_kureha.png]official website[/url]]
